milestones.title: Recursive-descent SQL parser
milestones.objective: Implement minisql/parser.py with parse_sql(sql: str) -> Any and parse_statements(sql: str) -> List[Any], importing AST nodes from minisql.ast_nodes and tokenize_sql from minisql.lexer. Parse CREATE TABLE [IF NOT EXISTS], DROP TABLE [IF EXISTS], CREATE INDEX [IF NOT EXISTS] idx ON tbl(col), INSERT INTO tbl [(cols)] VALUES (...), (...), UPDATE tbl SET col = expr, ... [WHERE ...], DELETE FROM tbl [WHERE ...], SELECT [DISTINCT] ... [FROM tbl [[AS] alias]] [INNER/LEFT [OUTER]/CROSS JOIN ...] [WHERE ...] [GROUP BY ...] [HAVING ...] [ORDER BY ... [ASC|DESC]] [LIMIT n [OFFSET m]], and transaction statements BEGIN [TRANSACTION], COMMIT [TRANSACTION], ROLLBACK [TRANSACTION], SAVEPOINT name, RELEASE [SAVEPOINT] name, ROLLBACK [TRANSACTION] TO [SAVEPOINT] name. Assign positional ? placeholders sequential 0-based indices within each statement, resetting to 0 at the start of each statement. In CREATE TABLE column DEFAULT <expr>, if the parsed default is a Literal, store default.value, evaluating unary -Literal to -default.value, directly in ColumnSpec.default. Parse precedence OR -> AND -> NOT -> IS [NOT] NULL / [NOT] IN / [NOT] BETWEEN / [NOT] LIKE / comparisons =, ==, !=, <>, <, <=, >, >= -> || -> +, - -> *, /, % -> unary +, - -> primary literals, ?, [table.]col, table.*, *, (expr), CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END, and FUNC([DISTINCT] ...) including COUNT(*). Raise MiniSQLError on invalid syntax. Include at least 5 real tests in tests/test_m2_sql_parser.py.

milestones.title: Storage catalog and expression evaluator
milestones.objective: Implement minisql/storage.py with in-memory catalog classes ColumnDef, Table, and Catalog, plus eval_expr(expr, row_ctx, params) and is_truthy(val). Apply type coercion/affinity for INT/INTEGER, REAL/FLOAT, TEXT/VARCHAR, and BOOL/BOOLEAN while preserving None as SQL NULL. Enforce PRIMARY KEY (implies NOT NULL and UNIQUE), UNIQUE (multiple NULLs allowed), NOT NULL, and DEFAULT application when columns are omitted on INSERT; if c.default is an AST Literal or expression, unwrap/evaluate it with eval_expr. Maintain secondary hash indexes for CREATE INDEX [IF NOT EXISTS] idx ON tbl(col) on insert/update/delete. Implement 3-valued NULL expression evaluation: arithmetic +, -, *, /, %, unary -, + returns None if any operand is NULL and division/modulo by 0 raises MiniSQLError; || converts numbers to str and returns None if either operand is NULL; comparisons return None if either operand is NULL; AND/OR/NOT use 3-valued truth tables; IS NULL, IS NOT NULL, [NOT] IN, [NOT] BETWEEN, [NOT] LIKE with case-insensitive ASCII % and _ matching and None if input or pattern is NULL; CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END. ParamPlaceholder(index) raises MiniSQLError if index >= len(params) or params is None. Scalar functions COALESCE, IFNULL, NULLIF, UPPER, LOWER, LENGTH, ABS, ROUND. Include at least 5 real tests in tests/test_m3_storage_and_expr.py.

milestones.title: Relational query and DML execution
milestones.objective: Implement minisql/engine.py with QueryExecutor and Database core. Execute CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, CREATE INDEX with if_not_exists, INSERT evaluating each expression in values_rows with eval_expr(expr, {}, params), checking column-value count match and returning QueryResult(rowcount=n), UPDATE returning QueryResult(rowcount=n), and DELETE returning QueryResult(rowcount=n). Implement full SELECT pipeline: FROM base table with optional alias plus chained INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN/LEFT OUTER JOIN, and CROSS JOIN, with LEFT JOIN padding unmatched right-side columns with None, and SELECT without FROM. WHERE keeps rows where is_truthy(eval_expr(where)) is True. GROUP BY partitions by group key; if group_by is empty and no aggregate appears in select_items or having, project each row individually; if group_by is empty but aggregates are present, treat all rows as one group even when empty, with COUNT -> 0 and SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX -> None, and support arithmetic over aggregates. HAVING filters grouped rows and supports aggregate expressions and SELECT output aliases. Project SELECT items including *, alias.*, expressions, AS alias, with DISTINCT deduplication and unqualified column names for * on a single table without joins. ORDER BY supports multi-key ASC/DESC, resolving column names, qualified names, SELECT aliases, or expressions, with None/NULL first in ASC and last in DESC. Apply OFFSET and LIMIT. Include at least 5 real tests in tests/test_m4_query_execution.py covering INSERT, SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY/HAVING, and ORDER BY/LIMIT.

milestones.title: Transactions, savepoints, and public facade
milestones.objective: Implement ACID transactions, savepoints, statement-level atomicity, and the public Database facade in minisql/engine.py and minisql/__init__.py. Support BEGIN [TRANSACTION], COMMIT, ROLLBACK using deep-copy catalog snapshots so ROLLBACK restores tables, rows, schema changes, and indexes exactly; raise MiniSQLError on COMMIT or ROLLBACK with no active transaction or BEGIN when already in a transaction. Support SAVEPOINT name, RELEASE [SAVEPOINT] name, and ROLLBACK [TRANSACTION] TO [SAVEPOINT] name, restoring state to the named savepoint while keeping the transaction active and raising MiniSQLError for unknown savepoint names. Before any mutating statement, save a catalog snapshot so MiniSQLError mid-statement rolls back partial modifications. Implement Database.__init__(self), execute(self, sql: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> QueryResult, and execute_script(self, sql_script: str) -> List[QueryResult], splitting semicolon-terminated statements while respecting quotes and comments and executing each in order. Export Database, QueryResult, and MiniSQLError from minisql/__init__.py. Include at least 5 real tests in tests/test_m5_transactions_and_facade.py verifying execute, execute_script, transactions, savepoints, and statement atomicity.
